Merge pull request #615 from cashubtc/docs/responsible-disclosure-guidance

Merge pull request #631 from cashubtc/fix/wallet-security-update

Fix a wallet security issue
fix: address wallet security issue

Merge pull request #627 from robwoodgate/feat/payment-request-tools

Payment requests: delete, description and lock to my key

Merge pull request #626 from robwoodgate/deps/noble-dedupe

Consolidate noble and scure dependency versions

Merge pull request #625 from robwoodgate/fix/payment-request-send-to-request

Handle NUT-18 payment requests end to end with cashu-ts 4.13

refactor: share amount conversion across wallet stores

Five stores each defined their own amountToNumber. They now use the
shared helpers in src/js/cashu-amount.ts: cashuAmountToNumber for
required fields, and a new cashuAmountOrZero where a missing amount
reads as 0.

refactor: use cashu-ts secp256k1 helpers for quote keys

Mint quote keys now come from cashu-ts createRandomSecretKey and
getPubKeyFromPrivKey, so the app no longer imports @noble/secp256k1,
which it never declared. Removes the unused dhke.js and its helpers.

chore(deps): consolidate noble and scure versions

Move nostr-tools to 2.25 and @scure/bip39 to 2.4, declare @noble/hashes
directly, and hold each noble/scure major line to one version with
overrides. App imports move to the v2 .js subpaths, and nip44/nip04
calls pass byte keys as nostr-tools 2.25 requires.

NDK, bc-ur, bolt12-utils and light-bolt11-decoder still need the v1
line, so two lines remain (13 versions, down from 19).
fix: update payment request description live and target delete by id

fix: start new payment requests on any mint

A new request carried over the mint of the one shown, and the mint chip can only pin a request to the active mint, so there was no way back to any mint.

fix: give the payment request dialog its own unit

The dialog used the wallet's active unit, so a request shown in another unit could be rewritten in the wrong one, and viewing a request changed the wallet's unit.

It now keeps the unit of the shown request, offers the units of that request's mint, and leaves the wallet's unit alone. The send and invoice dialogs still switch the wallet's unit.

Removes ToggleUnit.vue, which has no other users.

fix: preserve payment request terms when editing

Sync the displayed request unit with the unit control and honor the supplied mint URL when creating a replacement request. Add regression coverage for description and lock edits, paging, and deletion.

feat: delete, describe and lock payment requests

The request dialog gains a description field, a "Lock to my key"
toggle (P2PK to the wallet's newest key, NUT-11) and a delete button.
Its amount, mint, description and lock controls now show the terms of
the displayed request, so they stay right when paging or deleting.
fix: guard mismatched PR payments and invalid request amount edits

fix: keep the shown payment request in step with edits

Changing the amount, mint or unit now regenerates the shown request,
replacing it if nothing has been paid to it yet.

refactor: read token metadata amounts from proofAmounts

TokenMetadata.incompleteProofs is deprecated in cashu-ts 4.13 and removed
in v5. decodeMeta callers only need per-proof amounts, so read them from
proofAmounts.

fix: auto-receive payments for requests stored on another device

A payment whose request id is not stored locally (eg a request made on
another device with the same seed) can't be checked here, so receive it
as before rather than warning that it does not match.

feat: show a payment request's method fee before paying

When a request lists supported methods with a fee (NUT-18 sm/mf) and
the selected mint is not on its mint list, show the fee under the mint
picker and include it in the balance check.

feat: check incoming payment request payments before receiving

Parse NUT-18 payloads with PaymentRequest.decodePayload and check them
against our stored request with isPaymentRequestSatisfied. Automatic
receive now only takes payments that cover the request; anything else
is added to history and opened in the receive dialog with a warning.

fix: pay payment requests with cashu-ts sendToRequest

Bump cashu-ts to 4.13.0 and pay NUT-18 requests through
wallet.ops.sendToRequest, so the mint list, unit, per-method fee and
lock terms are applied by the library and the payee always nets the
requested amount after input fees. Payloads are built with
encodePayload.

A preferred mint list (mp) no longer blocks paying from another mint,
and the amount input is locked when the request sets its own amount.
History keeps the requested amount, with the request's fees in fee.

# Conflicts:
#	test/e2e/UI-TEST-REPORT.md

Merge pull request #643 from cashubtc/fix/welcome-redirect-without-reload

fix: redirect finished onboarding without reloading the app

Merge pull request #642 from cashubtc/fix/wallet-store-global-i18n

fix: create wallet store without a component instance
test: check the wallet store's t() translates outside a component

fix: disable the Nostr backup toggle while a backup is publishing

Toggling again before the first result arrived could show contradictory
messages or revert the setting after a success message.
fix: hide the empty camera preview when the scanner shows an error

fix: skip the active-mint fallback while any mint activation is in flight

Gating on addMintBlocking only covered addMint(). Removing the active mint,
or the fallback's own activation, still started a forced re-activation on
every render. Count in-flight activateMint() calls instead, and restore
spies after each test.

fix: keep PWA prompt arrow and seed buttons clear of larger tap targets

Place the Android install prompt's arrow above the box in normal flow so it
no longer depends on the box height, give the iOS prompt's close button the
same 32px tap target, and fit the two 32px seed buttons into the space the
seed text leaves free on narrow screens.

fix: replace the /welcome history entry when redirecting to the wallet

On Back from the wallet, the redirect matched the current route and was
dropped as a duplicate, leaving the address bar on /welcome. Force the
redirect and replace the entry so the URL and history match the wallet.

fix: enlarge small tap targets

Add a tap-target utility that gives compact buttons, clickable icons and
badges a hit area of at least 32px while icons and labels keep their size.
Apply it to the header refresh button, the install prompt close button, the
unit toggle in payment dialogs, settings action buttons and list icons, and
the restore page. Give the Paste label padding without moving it, and keep
the onboarding seed buttons at 32px on narrow screens.

test(e2e): drop expected-failure marker for UI-010

A fresh wallet no longer sets up seed-derived Nostr keys before onboarding,
so the initialization-error regression now passes.

test(e2e): drop expected-failure markers for UI-006 and UI-009

Creating the wallet store outside a component no longer throws, so seed
restore and direct Lightning address navigation now pass.

fix: don't re-activate the mint that addMint is still activating

addMint() lists a new mint before its info and keys are fetched, and only
sets activeMintUrl once activation succeeds. When it is the first mint,
every activeMint() call in that window hit the 'No active mint' fallback,
logged an error and started another forced activation of the same mint.
Adding a first mint fired 5 extra activations (6 /v1/info and 7 /v1/keys
requests instead of 1 and 2).

Skip the fallback activation while addMint is running.

fix: explain camera errors in the QR scanner

QrScanner.start() rejects when camera access is denied, no camera exists or
the camera cannot start. The promise was not handled, so the scanner showed
an empty video area with no explanation and logged an unhandled rejection.

Catch it and show a message in the scanner card.

fix: finish Nostr mint backup toggle after leaving Privacy

onNostrMintBackupToggle awaits enableBackup(), which publishes to relays.
If the user leaves the page meanwhile, vue-i18n has already removed $t
from the unmounted component, so the success message threw, the error
message threw again, and the toggle was never reverted: the setting stayed
on although enabling had failed.

Translate with the global i18n instance instead.

fix: skip seed-derived nostr setup until a wallet seed exists

On a first visit WalletPage runs initSigner() and
subscribeToNip17DirectMessages() before redirecting to onboarding. Both
derive keys from the wallet seed, which is still empty, so every fresh load
threw 'Invalid mnemonic' and a follow-up TypeError.

Only run them once a mnemonic exists; onboarding ends with a reload, so
they still run as soon as the wallet is set up.

fix: redirect finished onboarding without reloading the app

Pressing Back from the wallet after onboarding lands on /welcome, whose
mount hook set window.location.href = "/". That reloaded the whole app and
pushed a new history entry, so Back could never leave the app and each press
cost a full reload.

Redirect with a route guard on /welcome instead.

fix: create wallet store without a component instance

useWalletStore called useI18n() in its state factory. useI18n throws when
there is no current component instance, so the first useWalletStore() from
a store action (e.g. enabling the Nostr mint backup right after loading a
settings page) failed. Pinia had already registered the store, leaving a
store with no state: the home page then failed to render (blank screen) and
the backup page could not read the mnemonic.

Use the global i18n instance instead, like the mints store does.
fix: count only settled payments in a request's received total

fix: handle more P2PK lock states when picking a key

Stored keys are matched by x-coordinate.

fix: keep a payment request's id and selection stable

An unpaid request keeps its id and place in the list when edited, and deleting an earlier request no longer changes which one is shown.

fix: check a payment request's unit and methods before paying

The send dialog now warns and disables Pay when the active unit differs from the request's, or the selected mint offers none of its melt methods. Melt methods are read from the stored mint info instead of building a wallet.

Merge pull request #651 from cashubtc/fix/await-history-token-write

Await ecash history writes to IndexedDB

Address external review round 4 on history writes

- redeem: write history after releasing the wallet mutex, close the
  receive view only if it still shows the redeemed token, and add a paid
  row when the incoming entry has no stored row to update (setTokenPaid
  now reports whether it wrote).
- Payment requests: prepare the token for the same request that will be
  delivered to.
- Send dialog: after a successful history write, leave the view alone if
  the user closed it or opened another token meanwhile.
- nostr: show a token that could not be saved again after the rest of a
  multi-token message.
- checkTokenSpendable: report token/mint setup errors for checks the user
  started.
- splitHistoryToken: build the remainder from the stored row too.

Address external review round 3 on history writes

- SendPaymentRequest: keep the request it started with, so closing or
  changing the dialog after the proofs moved cannot cancel or redirect
  their delivery.
- Receive later: close the dialog only if it still shows the saved
  token, use the mapped store action, and disable Receive now while the
  save runs.
- Delete: close the token view only if it still shows the deleted token.
- splitHistoryToken: build the paid row from the stored row read inside
  the transaction, not the earlier cache snapshot.

Address external review round 2 on history writes

- tokens: status/edit writes check inside their transaction that the
  stored row still holds the expected token, so a full-spend status change
  cannot overwrite a split that committed meanwhile. deleteToken removes
  the cache entry only after the delete commits (the worker drops tokens
  missing from the cache).
- checkTokenSpendable: report a failed history write when the user
  started the check, and rethrow so the worker retries; the history table
  handles the rejected check.
- Send dialog: if the history write fails, show the dialog again so the
  token stays reachable even if it was closed during the write.
- nostr: an earlier message's save no longer closes the receive dialog
  that a later message opened.

Address external review round 1 on history writes

- tokens: apply status and edit changes to the cache only after the
  IndexedDB commit (the transaction worker must not prune a token on a
  'paid' that may still fail); split re-checks the stored row inside its
  transaction so overlapping checks add the remainder only once.
- redeem: save each history row on its own, so a failed status write on
  a self-sent token does not skip the incoming row.
- checkProofsSpendable: a failed history write no longer aborts the
  check or a caller's remaining batches.
- Send dialog: set the token view in one step after the history write,
  so closing the dialog meanwhile cannot leave it half set.
- Receive later and Delete: ignore repeat clicks while the write runs.
- Translate the history failure captions in all locales.

Keep an overlapping update from recreating a removed quote

updatePayment read the payment rows before its transaction and then
wrote the quote row unconditionally, so a status check that overlapped
removePaymentByQuote could write the deleted melt quote back. Read the
rows inside the transaction instead.

Also check the remaining references in removePaymentByQuote through the
parentQuote index instead of scanning the whole payment history.

Merge pull request #654 from cashubtc/docs/privacy-external-disclosure

Document mandatory privacy and external disclosure rules
Document mandatory privacy and external disclosure rules

Make the remaining ecash history writes safe on failure

- checkTokenSpendable: write the paid part and the pending remainder of a
  partially spent token in one IndexedDB transaction (new
  splitHistoryToken action), so the unspent proofs cannot drop out of
  history if one write fails.
- onTokenPaid: catch errors from the spent check in the websocket
  callback and release the subscription; the transaction worker keeps
  checking the token.
- deleteToken: await the delete, put the entry back in the cache and
  rethrow if it fails; the token view notifies and keeps the token.

Delete melt quote rows of failed payments

removePaymentByQuote now deletes the quote row of the removed payment in the
same transaction, unless another payment or a stored proof still references
it. The weekly sweep also removes orphaned UNPAID melt quotes that failed
sends left behind before this fix.

Merge pull request #650 from cashubtc/claude/prune-orphaned-quotes-4e0602

Delete quote rows of pruned payment history

Merge pull request #649 from cashubtc/claude/wallet-onboarding-dialog-width-67cc0f

fix(onboarding): consistent dialog width and content alignment

Treat quotes of pruned paid payments as settled

The wallet marks a minted bolt11 payment paid without persisting the
ISSUED quote state, so the ISSUED-only check kept nearly every pruned
bolt11 mint quote. A quote whose payments were all pruned as paid now
counts as settled (bolt11 mint and melt; bolt12/onchain still need
nothing left to claim).

Also pick the payments to prune from Dexie inside the transaction rather
than the in-memory cache, keep mint quotes with an unknown method or a
malformed amount, and cover the orphan sweep and queuedQuoteIds in tests.
Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into fix/await-history-token-write

Keep wallet flows going when a history write fails

Review follow-up:
- Send dialog: set sendData.historyToken before switching to the token
  view (the await between them let DisplayTokenComponent render without
  it), and show the token and start the checker even if the history
  write fails, since the proofs have already left the wallet. Same for
  payment-request delivery.
- redeem: a failed history write is notified but no longer reports an
  already-credited receive as failed.
- nostr: a failed history write no longer drops the incoming token; the
  receive dialog / auto-receive still run.
- tokens store: undo the optimistic in-memory change when the write fails,
  so retries and duplicate checks see the real IndexedDB state.
